sentences.text:
And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Amol Kumar Srivastava,Shivang Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar,J.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. read with Section 528 Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha
Sanhita, 2023 (in short "Bnss") has been filed by the applicant with the following reliefs:-
"a) To quash the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 89699 of 2019 titled as
"State vs. Sunil and Anr." along with the summoning order dated 25.10.2019 passed
by the learned Court of Special Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Cbi (A.P.), Lucknow,
arising out of Fir No. 612 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 147, 323, 504, 506 Ipc r/w
Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, P.S. Thakurganj, District Lucknow, and
charge sheet dated 14.04.2018 annexed as Annexure No. 3, 4, 5 respectively to the
Sunil Kumar And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 8 April, 2025

entities.text: Sunil Kumar And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: to refer the matter to the mediation centre of the Hon'ble Court so that the applicants and the opposite parties may have a chance to settle their dispute on their own terms through mediation, thereby, settling all their disputes through resolution mechanism of this Hon'ble court by way of Mediation and Conciliation including the settlement of the Criminal Case No. 89699 of 2019, titled as "State vs. Sunil & Anr."

arising out of FIR No. 612 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 147, 323, 504, 506 of IPC R/w Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station Thakurganj, District Lucknow, and charge sheet dated 14.04.2018, annexed as Annexure No. 3, 4, 5 respectively to the application."

Learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection regarding the maintainability of the present application that earlier also, the applicants have approached this Court by filing Application U/S 482 No. 636 of 2023, in which an interim order dated 24.01.2023 has been granted by this Court and thereafter the same was dismissed by order dated 16.05.2023.
After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicants may be permitted to withdraw the present application as dismissed as not pressed.
In view of above,the present Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. (now Section 528 B.N.S.S.) is dismissed as not pressed.
Order Date :- 8.4.2025 Nitesh  Sunil Kumar And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...
